transitions.title: Hard cut (no visible transition)
transitions.when_to_use: Default for most cuts (~2 of every 3). Instant jump; keeps reel pace without visual noise.

transitions.title: Flash through white
transitions.when_to_use: Punchy beat change, hook-to-body, or emphasis after a strong line. High retention reels.

transitions.title: Whip pan
transitions.when_to_use: Topic shift or energy spike; simulates fast camera move. Good on meaningful cuts only.

transitions.title: Digital glitch
transitions.when_to_use: Tech/error punchline, 'plot twist' beat, or deliberate disruption. Use sparingly.

transitions.title: Cinematic light leak
transitions.when_to_use: Warm emotional beat, B-roll handoff, or softer tonal shift without harsh flash.

transitions.title: Cinematic zoom blur
transitions.when_to_use: Dramatic reveal or 'zoom into' moment; pairs with impact SFX.

transitions.title: Iris wipe
transitions.when_to_use: Scene end, new section, or 'focus in' beat. Classic but visible — not every cut.

transitions.title: Domain warp dissolve
transitions.when_to_use: Organic morph between related ideas; smoother than glitch, more stylized than hard cut.

transitions.title: Cross warp morph
transitions.when_to_use: Conceptual link between two beats; noise-driven blend when both frames matter.

transitions.title: Ridged burn
transitions.when_to_use: Aggressive transition; conflict, destruction, or 'burn away' metaphor.

transitions.title: Ripple waves
transitions.when_to_use: Calmer passage change; water/flow metaphor or gentle section break.

transitions.title: Gravitational lens
transitions.when_to_use: Sci-fi or 'big idea' beat; warps space before landing the next line.

transitions.title: Chromatic split
transitions.when_to_use: Stylized punch; RGB separation on a key beat. Pairs with glitch-adjacent content.

transitions.title: Swirl vortex
transitions.when_to_use: Disorient-then-land beat; transition into a surprising statement.

transitions.title: Thermal distortion
transitions.when_to_use: Heat/tension buildup release; subtle compared to glitch, good for mid-energy beats.

sfx.character: Fast motion; pair with whip-pan, hard_cut energy spikes, or scene enters.
sfx.when_to_use: Meaningful cut with visible transition; section start.

sfx.character: Bright confirmation; checklist item, correct answer, small win.
sfx.when_to_use: Stat reveal, punchline landing, or motion graphic resolve.
flash-through-white, cinematic-zoom, or full-screen graphic slam.
Lower-third, callout, or half-screen graphic entrance.
Button/toggle metaphor, quick beat, or cut without heavy transition.

motion_graphic_templates.title: Matrix stat card
motion_graphic_templates.description: Glass panel over matrix/Three.js rain; one bold number + label animates in.

motion_graphic_templates.title: Glass quote fullscreen
motion_graphic_templates.description: Full-frame glassmorphism quote with kinetic typography; speaker line or pull quote.

motion_graphic_templates.title: Concept diagram (half screen)
motion_graphic_templates.description: Animated flow/diagram beside talking head; nodes and connectors reveal in sync with speech.

motion_graphic_templates.title: Matrix rain background (full screen)
motion_graphic_templates.description: Three.js or canvas matrix rain behind bold headline; high-concept, not generic lower-third.

motion_graphic_templates.title: Kinetic headline (full screen)
motion_graphic_templates.description: Full-screen single phrase with slam/wipe entrance; GSAP-driven, bold type.

motion_graphic_templates.title: Glass lower third (half screen)
motion_graphic_templates.description: Frosted bar with name/title/ stat; occupies lower half only, never a floating chip.

registry_notes.shader_demo_blocks: Individual shader previews install via hyperframes add <name> (e.g. flash-through-white). Runtime per-cut transitions use shader IDs from @hyperframes/shader-transitions, not registry block names.
registry_notes.showcase_galleries_note: Gallery blocks demo many CSS/GSAP transitions in one composition. They are NOT selectable per-cut shader IDs today. Do not add to transitions[] until wired.

reference_registry_blocks.kinetic-type: in registry.json as hyperframes:example only — NOT in hyperframes catalog / hyperframes add; use init --example. Treat as inspiration reference, not installable block.

verification.motion_graphic_template_ids: All six template ids (matrix-stat-card, etc.) are to-build sub-agent archetypes — none exist as registry items.
